inlines.v: ADRIAT'IC, adjective [Latin Aldria, or Hadria, the gulf of Venice.] Pertaining to the Gulf, called, from Venice, the Venetian Gulf. ADRIAT'IC, noun The Venetian Gulf; a Gulf that washes the eastern side of Italy.
